Due to the expansion of its location in Venlo, the company is looking for an experienced and motivated Reach Truck Driver. Wie zoeken we? You take initiative, keep your commitments and are willing to support colleagues whenever necessary. You value quality over speed and enjoy working in a structured logistics environment. Wat bieden wij je? Gross hourly wage starting at €16.33; Travel allowance; Full-time position, Monday to Friday; Stable, long-term employment opportunity; Professional logistics working environment; Opportunities for personal and professional development; Career growth opportunities within an international logistics provider. Your responsibilities include: Operating the reach truck to move and store goods safely and efficiently; Transporting pallets and goods to the correct warehouse locations; Supporting order preparation and shipment activities; Checking goods for correct quantities and visible damage; Ensuring goods are handled carefully and accurately; Identifying bottlenecks andproactively suggesting improvements; Supporting and assisting colleagues within the team; Following safety regulations and company procedures; Contributing to a clean, organized and structured warehouse.
